title: 28-Day Revision Plan
summary: A day-by-day schedule through every map, with review days and full mock tests before the big day.

blocks.text: About 30 minutes a day. Study the maps listed for the day, cover the answers and try the test questions. Review days go back over the traps. Watch every band: you need 20 out of 25 in each one.

sources.doc: GOV.UK: Approved driving instructor (ADI) part 1 test

review.checkedAgainst: Built from the verified maps; GOV.UK ADI part 1 test
